objective: Find robust technical strategies that generalize across four instruments rather than optimizing one market.
owner_goal: Boss becomes Customer #1 after the system proves robust and passes paper-trading and safety gates.
strategy_benchmark: Use the same primarily technical strategy library across all instruments wherever data is available. Rank candidates by robustness, not by single-market return.
validation: Fees + slippage, out-of-sample, walk-forward, parameter sensitivity, regime testing, drawdown and cross-instrument consistency.
